oauth.title: Allow access to your brains?
oauth.description: An AI app wants to read and write memories in Zekra on your behalf. Choose which brains it can use.
oauth.loopback: This app runs on your own computer (a local address). Only continue if you just started it yourself.
oauth.noBrains: You don't have any brains yet. Create one first, then connect again.
oauth.readOnlyRole: You can only read this brain
oauth.expires: Access refreshes automatically; revoke it any time under Connected apps.
